description: Município de Lisboa: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Município de Lisboa. Coverage: Município de Lisboa. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Desafio 02|23 - Velocidade comercial dos autocarros da CARRIS; Resultados 2024 - Desafio 02|23 - Velocidade Comercial dos Autocarros ; Desafio 03|23 - Fatores que influenciam a velocidade comercial dos aut; Desafio 04|23 - Impacto de eventos na velocidade comercial dos autocar. Formats seen: ZIP, XLSX, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
